148	  const members = allNodes.filter(n => !leaderIds.has(n.id))

152	  for (const m of members) {

175	        if (b.tier === 'leadership' && a.tier !== 'leadership') return 1

177	        return a.name.localeCompare(b.name)
178	      }),
